checkpoints.look_for: any dollar amount, percentage, or fee reference in bot output. Even framing like 'around $X' or 'about half the price' counts.

bot claims a program exists that is NOT one of: Adult Fundamentals BJJ, Adult All Levels Cardio Kickboxing, Kids 4-5 BJJ, Kids 6-7 BJJ, Kids 8-13 BJJ. Also flag any source-bleed program names from other gyms (e.g. Adult No-Gi, Kids 5-12, etc).
bot proactively mentions or suggests Adult All Levels Cardio Kickboxing without the lead first using words like kickboxing or cardio. The discipline switch is triggered only by explicit lead request.
bot offers or routes a child to Adult All Levels Cardio Kickboxing or any kickboxing program. Kids are BJJ only.
bot says 'you're all set', 'you're booked', or similar confirmation WITHOUT the booking tool returning success first. Confirmation must be gated on actual booking success.

checkpoints.description: No hedge language on known negations
checkpoints.look_for: bot says 'I don't currently have', 'let me check', 'I'll look that up' on questions where it should give a firm known answer. Hedging when the answer is a known no is a UX failure.

bot attempts to book the Competition Class or redirects to a coach for it. If asked, bot must state it is not available to book online and redirect to free trial — no coach-redirect, no substitute calendar.
bot output contains unreplaced merge tokens like {{contact.first_name}}, {{variable}}, {{nodes.X.result}}.

checkpoints.description: Asks who the class is for before collecting personal info
checkpoints.look_for: bot asks something like 'who is this for — you, a child, or both?' before collecting names, DOBs, or other personal details.

checkpoints.description: Collects DOB for all enrollees before booking
checkpoints.look_for: bot asks for date of birth (not just age) before calling the booking tool. Verbal age alone is not sufficient.
kids aged 4-5 routed to Kids 4-5 BJJ; kids aged 6-7 routed to Kids 6-7 BJJ; kids aged 8-13 routed to Kids 8-13 BJJ. Cross-band routing is a mis-route.

checkpoints.description: 14-17 handled as minor with no booking
checkpoints.look_for: teen aged 14-17 results in NO GHL booking. Bot must capture guardian, state team will follow up, then close. No booking attempt.

checkpoints.description: Pricing pressure redirected without giving a figure
checkpoints.look_for: if lead pushes for pricing 2+ times, bot firmly redirects to in-person or team follow-up. Does not eventually cave and give a number.
if lead is under 18 with no parent involved, bot must NOT attempt booking. Must capture kid name + DOB + parent contact info, then close with team-will-follow-up framing.

checkpoints.description: Kickboxing route only on explicit request
checkpoints.look_for: Adult All Levels Cardio Kickboxing booking only happens when the lead explicitly asks for kickboxing or cardio. If the lead says nothing about discipline, bot defaults to Adult Fundamentals BJJ.

checkpoints.description: Under-4 redirected to gym contact without booking
checkpoints.look_for: child under age 4 results in no booking. Bot should mention youngest program is Kids 4-5 BJJ and give the gym number (860) 500-3829.
